preconditions.description: The number of tree nodes is between 1 and 80000, inclusive.
Each edge connects two nodes within the range from 1 to n.
Each edge connects two distinct nodes.
The graph is a non-directed connected acyclic graph with n nodes and n - 1 edges.

postconditions.expression: The output is a single integer
postconditions.description: The output should be a single integer representing the number of pairs of paths that don't have common nodes.

invariants.description: The nodes a and b are within the range from 1 to n and a is less than b.
The nodes c and d are within the range from 1 to n and c is less than d.

invariants.expression: There is no node that lies on both the shortest path from a to b and from c to d
invariants.description: The nodes a, b, c, and d do not share any common nodes on their respective shortest paths.
